niche.habitat: Drifting Isles subsurface fractures and surface; nests in radiogenic heat vents.
niche.diet: Ammonia-water eutectic fluids, silicate inclusions, radiolytic oxidants; digests via chemolithotrophy.
niche.active: Continuous but slow; accelerates near heat sources or during flybys.

body: Asymmetric armored thorax with silicate plates; internal ammonia-brine circulation; chemical blowhole vent; crystalline memory lobes.

links: Accumulated silicate inclusions form armor plates
Porosity allows shock absorption in microgravity

skill.effect: The silicate armor hardens around nearby allies, strongly deflecting strikes and shielding them from ground hazards for a short while.

chains.weakness: Heavy armor reduces movement speed and agility.
observe: Plates click and shift as it moves.
Dust bounces off the thorax with visible sparks.
Body is lopsided, armored on one side.

journal.en: A walking icebox of poison and patience.

plausibility.summary: Without an atmosphere (F9–F10), micrometeoroids strike at hypervelocity; silicate inclusions in F13 ice can sinter into asymmetric plates. Low g (F5) reduces weight penalty; porous shock layers are consistent with fracture-dwelling macrofauna (still highly speculative per F18, but smaller than Velafrío).

body_plan.origin: Evolves from burrowing brine-colonies that developed rigid armor to survive dust impacts; internal circulation evolved to manage radiolytic byproducts in insulated fractures.

temperament: Territorial guardian; defensive; hoards solvent; wary of Velafrío.
secrets: Its ammonia can thaw frozen brine pockets.
Its armor is pure magnetite; can be used for navigation.
The crystalline lobes hold the history of the isle's journey.
moments: The Polvorín hunches over the player's shelter, and a jet of supercooled ammonia mist hisses from its blowhole, instantly freezing the cracks in the rock where life might hide.

journal.en: It turns the universe's radiation into a slow, freezing breath.
Armor of dust, heart of poison, memory of ice.
